notes.title: Development version 1.2.2
notes.content:
1. The last maze map, which received many inquiries, has been deleted. We will add a map after improving it a bit more.
2. There was an issue where you could break through the map by climbing on a pillar. I solved the problem by modifying the sitting logic.
3. There were cases where the player was trapped in an inescapable space and could not get out. A transparent wall was installed to prevent only players from entering.

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.2.1
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was visible when starting the game.
2. Fixed screen resolution issue.

notes.title: 03/04/2024 Develop 1.2 Patches
notes.content:
1. The beginning of the first stage has been changed.

2. The front part of the Tutorial 3 map has been changed.
2.1 We lowered the difficulty in the early part.
2.2 The problem-solving method has been changed to be easier to understand.

3. Fixed infinite death bug. This bug occurred when monsters in the maze map invaded the player's save point. Therefore, the locations of the monsters were changed.
